add.evidence: In 1990, the novo kwanza was introduced, with the ISO 4217 code AON.

add.event: 调整宽扎以1000比1取代旧宽扎
add.evidence: In 1995, the kwanza reajustado (plural kwanzas reajustados) replaced the previous kwanza at a rate of 1,000 to 1.

add.event: 推出第二种名为宽扎的货币
add.evidence: In 1999, a second currency was introduced simply called the kwanza.

add.event: 币值稳定期结束，宽扎再度贬值
add.evidence: its value became stable until 2016, when the currency started devaluing again.
